answer: Before dawn of each voting round, every identity must answer a rotating proof-of-service ping: each node receives a fresh query routed through a random oasis relay, and its signed signal must arrive before the quorum window closes. A node that misses three consecutive pings is delisted, and any relay that certified the silent identity forfeits 20% of its own posted stake. An attacker keeping fake identities alive must pay sustained cost per account - every silent clone causes its sponsoring relay to lose 20% of stake, so each fake identity costs more with every round it lingers.
